html:
Perks › Legendary

Turncoat

Legendary perk · Active ability

Reveal Rival's rack and choose both bones to swap. After use, wait through the next hand before using it again.

In-game card text

How it works

See Rival's whole rack, then choose one of your bones and one of Rival's bones to swap.

  • Once per hand however many copies you hold. After you use it, it rests for the next hand and is ready again the hand after that.
  • Using it does not end your turn.
  • Unlike Table Thief, the traded bones are not revealed to the table.

At a glance

RarityLegendary
TypeActive ability
UsesOne use per hand no matter how many copies you hold. After you use it, it rests for the next 1 hand.
How to get itComplete its three career trials (Win 30 hands; Acquire 15 different perks; Win 5 matches), then unlock it for 1,500 Bone Bucks.
